post.summary: Create an access token for plugin (client)

oauth2.description:
Use the token from the authentication endpoint in the Authorization header.

Example: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`

client_id.description: The client ID associated to the plugin for this environment.

client_secret.description: The client secret associated to the plugin for this environment.

company_id.description: The unique ID of the company.

plugin_id.description: The unique ID of the plugin.

token_type.description: The type of the access token.

access_token.description: The access token that authorizes access to API resources. Include the access token in the `Authorization` header of every request as `Bearer`.

expires_in.description: The lifetime of the access token in seconds.

temporaryToken.description: The temporary token from an authed user on a core product.
